articles.title_en: The Supply-Side Effects of Monetary Policy
articles.title_cn: 货币政策的供给侧效应
articles.abstract_en: We propose a supply-side channel for the transmission of monetary policy. We show that when high-markup firms have lower pass-throughs than low-markup firms, then positive demand shocks, such as monetary expansions, alleviate cross-sectional misallocation by reallocating resources to high-markup firms. Consequently, positive “demand shocks” are accompanied by endogenous positive “supply shocks” that raise productivity and lower inflation. We derive a tractable, four-equation model where monetary shocks generate hump-shaped productivity responses. In our calibration, the supply-side effect amplifies the total impact of monetary shocks on output by about 70%. We provide empirical evidence validating our model’s predictions using identified monetary shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了货币政策传导的供给侧渠道。我们表明，当高加成率企业的传导率低于低加成率企业时，正向需求冲击（如货币扩张）通过将资源重新配置给高加成率企业来缓解横截面错配。因此，正向“需求冲击”伴随着内生的正向“供给冲击”，从而提高生产率并降低通胀。我们推导出一个易于处理的四方程模型，其中货币冲击产生驼峰形的生产率响应。在我们的校准中，供给侧效应将货币冲击对产出的总影响放大了约70%。我们使用识别的货币冲击提供了实证证据，验证了我们模型的预测。

articles.title_en: Impacts of a Large-Scale Parenting Program: Experimental Evidence from Chile
articles.title_cn: 大规模育儿项目的影响：来自智利的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We present results from a large-scale experimental evaluation of a national parenting program in Chile. The program is low cost: it lasts only 6–8 weeks, and it is administered to groups of eight to 12 parents. It is implemented by the national health system, taking advantage of its existing physical infrastructure and human resources. We find that 3 years after the interventions ends, children whose parents are offered the opportunity to participate in this program increase their vocabulary and socioemotional development scores by 0.1 standard deviations, mirrored by similar improvements in caregiver’s parenting behaviors and beliefs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们展示了一项针对智利全国育儿项目的大规模实验评估结果。该项目成本低廉：仅持续6-八周，并以每组8至12名家长的形式进行管理。它由国家卫生系统实施，利用其现有的物理基础设施和人力资源。我们发现，在干预结束3年后，被提供参与该项目机会的家长的孩子的词汇量和社会情感发展得分提高了0.1个标准差，这与照护者育儿行为和信念的类似改善相呼应。

articles.title_en: The ABCs of Firm Heterogeneity When Firms Sort into Markets: The Case of Exporters
articles.title_cn: 企业异质性的ABC：当企业选择进入市场时——以出口企业为例
articles.abstract_en: We develop a novel methodology for disentangling the demand and cost drivers of firm heterogeneity when firms sort themselves into different markets, and we apply it to export status differences. Our methodology results in joint estimates of firm-level productivity and of markups in every market, without imposing functional form restrictions on demand. We find that exporters, relative to nonexporters, (i) have flatter domestic demand curves—thicker domestic markets—and (ii) have higher demand conditional on productivity. Finally, (iii) these demand advantages translate to foreign markets, thereby leading to export status differences.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种新颖的方法论，用于在企业选择进入不同市场时分解企业异质性的需求和成本驱动因素，并将其应用于出口状态差异。我们的方法论在不施加需求函数形式限制的情况下，得出了每个市场中企业层面生产率和加价率的联合估计。我们发现，相对于非出口企业，出口企业（i）具有更平坦的国内需求曲线——更厚的国内市场——以及（ii）在给定生产率条件下具有更高的需求。最后，（iii）这些需求优势延伸到国外市场，从而导致出口状态差异。

articles.title_en: A Theory of Stock Exchange Competition and Innovation: Will the Market Fix the Market?
articles.title_cn: 证券交易所竞争与创新理论：市场能否修复市场？
articles.abstract_en: Will stock exchanges innovate to address latency arbitrage and the arms race for speed? This paper models how exchanges compete in the modern electronic era and how this shapes incentives for market-design innovation. In the status quo, exchange trading fees are competitive, but exchanges earn economic rents from selling speed. These rents create a wedge between private and social incentives to innovate and support the persistence of an inefficient market design in equilibrium of a market-design adoption game. We discuss implications for policy and insights for the literatures on market design, innovation, and platforms.
articles.abstract_cn: 证券交易所是否会创新以解决延迟套利和速度军备竞赛问题？本文建模了交易所如何在现代电子时代竞争，以及这如何塑造市场设计创新的激励。在现状下，交易所交易费用具有竞争性，但交易所通过出售速度获得经济租金。这些租金在私人和社会创新激励之间制造了楔子，并在市场设计采纳博弈的均衡中支持了低效市场设计的持续存在。我们讨论了政策含义以及对市场设计、创新和平台文献的见解。

articles.title_en: Improving the Organization of Knowledge in Production by Screening Problems
articles.title_cn: 通过筛选问题改进生产中的知识组织
articles.abstract_en: We extend Garicano’s model of optimal organizations by allowing problems to be screened. We show that when screening is as costly as solving problems, optimal organizations are hierarchies as in Garicano’s model, but when the cost of screening is small, workers screen all problems that they and the top managers cannot solve, those problems that they screen are sent directly to those who can solve them, and those problems that they neither solve nor screen are passed to the top managers. For intermediate values of the screening cost, the optimal organization is a hybrid of the above forms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们扩展了Garicano的最优组织模型，允许对问题进行筛选。我们表明，当筛选成本与解决问题成本相同时，最优组织是如Garicano模型中的层级结构，但当筛选成本较小时，工人会筛选所有他们自己和高层管理者无法解决的问题，他们筛选出的问题直接发送给能解决这些问题的人，而他们既不解决也不筛选的问题则传递给高层管理者。对于筛选成本的中间值，最优组织是上述形式的混合体。

articles.abstract_en: We present a menu-cost pricing model with a large but finite number n of firms. A firm’s nominal price increase lowers other firms’ relative prices, thereby inducing further nominal price increases. The distribution of these “repricing avalanches” converges as n→∞ to a mixture of generalized Poisson distributions with an indexofdispersion=1/(1−θ)2, where θ is determined by the equilibrium of the continuous limit. We calibrate the model to the US experience during 1988–2005 and obtain a θ surprisingly close to unity. Our model accounts for the positive relationship between inflation level and volatility observed in the data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个菜单成本定价模型，其中有大量但数量有限的 n 家公司。一家公司的名义价格上涨会降低其他公司的相对价格，从而导致名义价格进一步上涨。这些“重新定价雪崩”的分布随着 n→∞ 收敛到广义泊松分布的混合，其离散指数=1/(1−θ)2，其中 θ 由连续极限的平衡确定。我们根据1988-2005期间美国的经验校准模型，并获得令人惊讶地接近统一的θ。我们的模型解释了数据中观察到的通胀水平和波动性之间的正相关关系。
